title: Agentic Context Engineering
content: ACE uses a Generator, Reflector and Curator to evolve an agent's context through accumulated experience. It maintains an evolving playbook of strategies, knowledge and lessons.

title: GEPA Optimization
content: GEPA uses reflective feedback and evolutionary search to optimize prompts and agent configurations. It evaluates candidates and uses Pareto-based selection to preserve diverse high-performing solutions.

title: Agent Evaluation
content: An agent should be evaluated using task success, correctness, tool selection accuracy, execution errors, latency and regression tests.
